title: Reasonable probability distribution
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite type, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $B\in\mathbb{R}$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. Say that $X$ is reasonable with parameter $B$ under $p$ if $1\le B$ and the expectation of $X^4$ under $p$ is at most $B$ times the square of the expectation of $X^2$ under $p$.
hypotheses_covered: Fourth-moment bound by $B$ times the squared second moment
